question.text: Kaveri Macro Fund is launching a Large Value Fund (LVF) for Accredited Investors under Category III. What is the minimum investment amount per investor (other than Sponsor/Manager or their employees) in an LVF?

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Large Value Fund for Accredited Investors means an AIF/scheme in which each investor (other than Manager/Sponsor and their employees/directors) is an Accredited Investor AND invests not less than INR 25 crore. General minimum for AIFs is INR 1 cr; employee-director minimum is INR 25 lakh; LVF is INR 25 cr. **The Trap:** Option A is general AIF minimum. Options B and D are plausible but wrong figures. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-B, XIX-C test LVF directly. XIX-E cares as LVF unlocks the 20% concentration concession for Cat III. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** LVF status unlocks: 20% concentration limit, faster extensions, PPM audit relaxation. But LVF investors cannot withdraw AI consent mid-scheme — design contribution agreement accordingly.
